LIMIT 1;

walk_actors.question: Which actors appear in the most films?

SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, count(fa.film_id) AS film_count
FROM actor a
JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id
GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name
ORDER BY film_count DESC
LIMIT 5;
runs.answer: Gina DeGeneres appears in the most films with 42 appearances, followed closely by Walter Torn with 41 films and Mary Keitel with 40 films.
